name: description
label: Description
default: MDCompass examines six organizational dimensions. Together, they form a complete diagnostic picture of how your organization runs, decides, and grows.

children.label: text
children.default:
The strategic "why" behind the marketing effort: market differentiation and go-to-market credibility. Positioning, messaging, and a unique point of view determine whether marketing lands or disappears.

  • "Can every leader articulate what makes us different in the same way?"

  • "Does our messaging reflect our positioning, or our assumptions about it?"

name: note
label: Note
default: What AI does not do: interpret, conclude, or decide what findings mean. The rubric actively reduces bias by anchoring scores to observable behaviors and removing the influence of title, tenure, or confidence. If a score cannot be defended with evidence, it is not assigned. People interrogate the data. That work happens in facilitated sessions, not in the scoring model.

name: callout
label: Callout
default: AI makes the evidence defensible. The facilitation makes it actionable. Neither works without the other.
